description: Diagnose device, app, development-server, and React Native or Expo readiness issues. Returns compact evidence for local inventory, sessions, optional app discovery, toolchains, and server reachability. On iOS simulators it also warms the XCTest runner build cache in the background when missing, so run it before the first Apple snapshot or interaction of a session. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

remote.description: Check remote connection setup instead of local device inventory.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

targetApp.description: Installed app package/bundle id or app name to verify without opening a session.

name: doctor
